name: @red-cup-engineering/casino-service-561-group
description: casino.561.group — Cowrie Casino: a real, monetized social casino. No real-money wagering or payouts, ever; monetization is tickets-for-play (timed regeneration plus purchasable bundles) spending down into chips, the play currency. Every ticket and chip balance is a @red-cup-engineering/energy-bank double-entry ledger account (this is energy-bank's first live integration), auditable as an hledger journal. Blackjack (src/games/blackjack/) is the first real table game: a seeded 6-deck shoe from @red-cup-engineering/card-table, real chip stakes through the same ledger, dealer plays a published H17/S17 policy, and an optional House Math panel discloses the exact expected value of every move against the table's own live shoe. "Tideline Treasures" (src/games/slots/) is the flagship spectacle game: a 5-reel/3-row/20-payline video slot on @red-cup-engineering/parlor-kernel's new multi-payline grid math (wilds, scatters, a retriggerable free-spin bonus, a progressive jackpot fed by the house's shared pool), rendered with @red-cup-engineering/qwzspace's procedural drawables/tween/particles/camera/celebration spectacle layer and scored with @red-cup-engineering/resonator's procedural audio — every RTP/odds figure computed by exact enumeration or closed-form analysis, never asserted, and disclosed live in its own House Math panel.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --noCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target esnext src/*.mts src/economy/*.mts src/games/blackjack/*.mts src/games/slots/*.mts src/floor/*.mts && for f in web/js/*.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node --test src/*.test.mts src/economy/*.test.mts src/games/blackjack/*.test.mts src/games/slots/*.test.mts src/floor/*.test.mts
